rule: The domestic routes between cities flown by at least 3 airlines (scheduled or seasonal; charter-only airlines not counted), from the airlines-and-destinations tables of the English and Vietnamese Wikipedia articles on Vietnam's airports (current revisions, see air_routes.json): an airline counts for a pair of airports when the articles of both airports list it. Routes are ranked by airlines, ties broken by the passengers of the route's airports (latest ACV year compiled on Wikipedia). Each route links the cities whose former provinces hold the two airports.
path_note: Drawn as an arc between the two cities: Wikipedia's tables list which airports each airline links, not how many flights or passengers each route has, and they can lag behind airline schedule changes.

zones.name: Buôn Ma Thuột · Đắk Lắk (former province)

international.rule: International routes: a Vietnamese airport and a foreign airport listed in the Vietnamese airport's English or Vietnamese Wikipedia article (the foreign airport's article is not read), counting the airlines that are not charter-only. Routes to an airport inside the map frame flown by at least 2 airlines are drawn as arcs; the others are listed. Destination names are the English articles' link labels, or OurAirports' airport name where only a Vietnamese article links the airport.
